This Visit

Rooms reviewed: Master Bathroom, Master Bedroom, Main Living Area, Kitchen, Hallway, Den, Guest Bedroom, Guest Bedroom Bath

Decisions needed from you: 4

Decisions Needed

  1. Master bathroom: frost the shower glass and add a curtain matching the bedroom curtains, so light continues into the space.
  2. Main living area: cover the TV unit openings up to the ceiling and add a wallpaper feature wall.
  3. Kitchen: the recommended Pebble 468 Matte X-8 finish.
  4. Guest bedroom: keep the existing curtains and match the rest of the curtains in the property to them.

MASTER BATHROOM

Demo of the existing lights, mirror, tiles, cabinetry and sinks is still to be completed, as part of the original scope quoted by the general contractor.
DECISION NEEDED
The shower area is to be refinished. The recommendation is to frost the glass and add a curtain matching the bedroom curtains, which allows light to continue into a space that could otherwise read dark. Pending a quote from the general contractor, including demo and installation.

MASTER BEDROOM

The ceiling cracks have been repaired. The next step is paint, with the color still to be determined.

MAIN LIVING AREA

The ceiling crack repairs have been completed, as in the master bedroom.
DECISION NEEDED
The recommended solution is to cover the openings in the TV unit and carry the covering up to the ceiling rather than removing the unit, as the resulting floor damage could not be repaired. Pending a quote from the general contractor. JCI will then source and install wallpaper as a feature wall.
Detail of the lighting that will also be eliminated.
The two mirrors and three light fixtures currently on the floor are to be disposed of.

KITCHEN

DECISION NEEDED
Two finish samples were reviewed on site. The recommendation is the Pebble 468 Matte X-8 finish, with Cashmere 725 Soft Touch as the alternate.
Kitchen demo and installation are pending a quote from the general contractor. Installation is to be handled by the general contractor, with supervision from the millworker.

HALLWAY

The hallway has been cleared. The next step is to repair the holes.

DEN

The wall finish is still to be removed, which is next, along with repairing the holes left in the wall.

GUEST BEDROOM

DECISION NEEDED
The light fixture has been removed. The recommendation is to keep the existing curtains, which are in very good shape, and match the rest of the curtains in the property to them.

GUEST BEDROOM BATH

Demo of the sink and mirror is pending with the general contractor.
